## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: SPY (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND with TLT (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND (SPY/TLT ↓ falling) and HYG/LQD showing stress (HYG 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.14% CORRECTION vs LQD 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.90% ABOVE TREND) — two independent confirmations for caution.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ (HYG 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.14% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.90% ABOVE TREND). Fear tick higher: VXX (1W: +3.33% | 1M: -5.84%) ↑ rising RECOVERY; Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -5.31%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND and Yield Curve (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +2.08%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, while Dollar Strength (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.74%) → flat ABOVE TREND keeps policy leverage constrained.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Biotech and Healthcare leading: XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND; Financials steady: XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND — style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US small caps outperforming: IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND. Emerging markets and China lag: EEM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND; FXI (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.89%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND shows risk-on in small caps, but IBIT (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.57% | 1M: +0.23%) CORRECTION show constrained crypto/innovation speculation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity weakness: GLD (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND; selective strength in nat gas: UNG (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY while oil proxies BNO (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND — divergence between energy equities and commodity oil prices.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) and Small Caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%). DIVERGENCE: SOXX in CORRECTION (1W: -7.74% | 1M: +4.65%), multiple sector corrections (MTUM, ARKK, HYG) signal minor-to-moderate cross-market rotation rather than a clean regime shift.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective cyclicals and healthcare/biotech (XLF 1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55% ABOVE TREND; XLV 1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24% ABOVE TREND; XBI 1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68% ABOVE TREND) and monitor bond exposure via TLT (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +2.82% ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to broad Tech (XLK 1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68% BELOW TREND) and precious metals (GLD 1W: -3.48% | 1M: -8.53% BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Healthcare/Biotech — XLV (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND; Materials pressure XME (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -12.06%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil/precious metals — BNO (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND; SLV (1W: -10.47% | 1M: -21.07%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~23–25 (current VIX proxy VXX 1W: +3.33% | 1M: -5.84% RECOVERY) as a fear watch; HYG/LQD ~0.73 (Credit stress signal, HYG 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.14% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.90% ABOVE TREND); SPY/TLT ~8.34 (Stocks vs Bonds 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -5.31% ↓ falling) and XLK/XLF ~3.38 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -5.52% | 1M: -7.45% ↓ falling).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but credit and stock-vs-bond signals are deteriorating. Healthcare/biotech and small caps showing strength (XLV 1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24% ABOVE TREND; XBI 1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68% ABOVE TREND). Key risk: rising short-term fear and HYG/LQD deterioration alongside tech weakness (XLK 1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68% BELOW TREND) — monitor VXX, HYG/LQD and SOXX divergence.
